item.title_tr: Standard soccer ball Type 3 layers Leather ball No. 5 FOOTBALL NUMBER 5 HIGH QUALITY LEATHER NEW SUPER PRODUCT
item.description_tr:
1 X Ball

Combination items:
1 X Pump
1 X Ball net bag
2 X Pump Needle

✅ PRODUCT INFORMATION

♢ Size: Size 5

♢ Diameter: 215 mm

♢ Weight = 400g

♢ Bounce: 125 – 130 cm

♢ Roundness < 3.5 mm

♢ Water permeability < 10%

The outer surface is scratch resistant and water resistant

The ball has a multi-layer structure inside that is added with a cushion fabric to help the ball be softer and keep its form well

The ball is made of special rubber, keeping the air well. The ball has stable flight and bounce

The ball is suitable for kicking on artificial turf, natural turf and ground

Balls can compete in all weather conditions

Limit kicking on concrete courts, where sharp objects make the ball easy to wear and scratch

Store in a dry place, away from direct light and high temperature
